verdicts.reason: The two use the same weak layout. The full-bleed photo became a small inset on a plain white canvas, the second TRX photo shrank to an unreadable thumbnail stuck at the bottom, and the yellow headline blocks are now orphaned shapes floating over the left photo. Text is readable, but the headline group is cut off from the imagery and there is dead white space around everything. A adds a tall vertical yellow bar that forms a strange 'F' shape over the photo, so it looks even more like random debris. B's two plain bars are slightly less distracting.
